# 3 bedroom terraced house for sale

> Our latest listing is a 3 bedroom mid-terrace house located in Darlington. It is in close proximity to valuable amenities, is able to generate rewarding rental returns and has a tenant currently situated. This property features 3 bedrooms, lounge, kitchen, 2 bathrooms, front and back garden space and private driveway parking.

- Dispozice: 3 bedrooms
- Plocha: 83 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: Dunrobin Close, Darlington
- Cena: £100,000
